description: DINOv3 continual self-supervised pre-training. Domain-adapts public DINOv3 ViT backbones on unlabeled images via teacher-student self-distillation (DINO + iBOT + KoLeo, optional Gram anchoring) and converts the EMA teacher into a timm-format backbone for downstream tasks. Trigger phrases include "train DINOv3", "DINOv3 SSL", "domain-adapt a foundation backbone", "continual pretraining", "self-supervised finetune DINOv3".
